title: Website-first walkthrough capture
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for checking website-first walkthrough shot lists and generating deterministic browser recorder plans in the v6 capture window (1280x613 CSS px at device scale 1.5) with real surface hosts, take ids, request-band anchors, 1.8 s minimum shots, reading-speed holds, no status stamps and zero camera drift.
boundaries: Walkthrough footage shots record real pages at scale 1.000 with 0 px drift, visible browser chrome, take ids and zero credentials in URLs.
Overlay callouts never carry forbidden status stamps, retired names or 'proven' lifecycle claims and stay within 8 words while narration speaks.
Admitting a storyboard check and recorder plan requires an independent distinct_reviewer.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for checking website-first walkthrough shot lists and generating deterministic browser recorder plans in the v6 capture window (1280x613 CSS px at device scale 1.5) with real surface hosts, take ids, request-band anchors, 1.8 s minimum shots, reading-speed holds, no status stamps and zero camera drift

value.lets_workers: Validate multi-cut walkthrough storyboards before recording (back-to-back shot seams, >= 1.8 s shots, permitted live hosts, zero URL credentials, request-page band anchors, reading-time budgets, stamp and retired-name blocks, camera scale 1.000) and emit deterministic browser recorder plans.

flow.when: Independently check a walkthrough storyboard against all film-frame v6 footage, pacing, URL-hygiene and wording rules.
Compile a recorder capture plan for a cut with 1280x613 CSS px viewport, device scale 1.5, take ids and scroll/pointer bounds.

value.worked_example: Three-cut v3 storyboard (180 s, 60 s and 90 s technical cut) checked in test_walkthrough_capture.py: passes with zero errors, produces recorder steps at 1280x613 CSS px (device scale 1.5) anchored to #step-split..#step-ready, and blocks mutated flash cuts, stamp overlays, Ken Burns drift, off-site URLs, URL credentials and retired names.
provenance_notes: Checks footage URLs against the live Eranos (eranos.ta-amps.workers.dev) and Agora (agora.ta-amps.workers.dev) Cloudflare Workers surfaces.

nouns.title: Guardrail: walkthrough footage stays on permitted live pages at scale 1.000 with zero credentials in URLs
nouns.category_reason: Preserves authentic browser walkthroughs and enforces the access contract forbidding URL tokens.

value.rule: Footage shots use permitted live surface HTTPS hosts with take_ids, never place key/token/code/secret parameters in URLs, anchor request-status shots to #step-split..#step-ready, and hold camera scale 1.000 with 0 px drift.
value.how_it_is_checked: walkthrough_capture.check_storyboard rejects off-site URLs, CREDENTIAL_IN_URL matches, missing anchors, camera scale != 1.0 or drift != 0.0.

nouns.title: Guardrail: walkthrough storyboard check receipts require an independent reviewer
nouns.category_reason: Ensures shot-list hygiene is verified independently before browser capture begins.

value.rule: The worker checking a walkthrough storyboard before capture cannot share worker_id or key_id with the storyboard author.

nouns.title: Specification: film-frame v6 1280x613 CSS px capture window, 1.8 s shot floor and scroll/callout bounds
nouns.category_reason: Defines deterministic browser capture geometry and pacing rules for real-page walkthroughs.

nouns.title: Tool card: standard-library walkthrough storyboard checker and v6 browser recorder planner
nouns.category_reason: Tested Python 3.10+ standard-library package pinned by path, file count and SHA-256.

value.name: walkthrough capture
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Checks multi-cut storyboards for shot seams, 1.8 s minimum shots, permitted hosts, URL credential bans, band anchors, reading budgets, stamp/retired-name bans and static camera scale.
Builds per-cut recorder capture plans with take_ids, URLs, anchors, 1280x613 CSS px window and scroll/pointer rules.
Verifies SHA-256 retired-name matching and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.
does_not: Launch headless browsers on import, embed credentials in URLs or apply artificial zoom/pan effects.

value.describes: a deterministic pre-recording check receipt over a multi-cut walkthrough storyboard

nouns.title: Template: website-first browser recorder plan for a walkthrough cut

value.describes: an ordered browser capture plan with viewport dimensions, device scale, take ids and anchors

nouns.title: Worked example: three-cut storyboard v3 verified against v6 footage, anchor and pacing rules
nouns.category_reason: Storyboard v3 fixture checked deterministically by test_walkthrough_capture.py.

value.shows: All three cuts (180 s, 60 s and 90 s technical cut) pass check_storyboard() with zero errors and produce valid 1280x613 CSS px capture plans.

verbs.title: Check a walkthrough shot list before browser recording
verbs.summary: Verify with a distinct reviewer that a walkthrough storyboard has back-to-back shots >= 1.8 s, permitted live hosts, take ids, request-band anchors, reading-time holds, zero URL credentials and zero stamp or retired-name hits.

steps: Run check_storyboard(sb) across all cuts in the pinned storyboard.
Confirm zero error tuples, zero URL credential parameters and distinct reviewer identity.

slots.name: storyboard
slots.description: Pin of the checked walkthrough storyboard.

cut_id.description: Identifier of the cut inside the storyboard to plan.

steps: Run capture_plan(sb, cut_id) to extract every footage shot with its take_ids, URL, anchor and minimum hold duration.
Verify every step carries window_css_px [1280, 613], device_scale_factor 1.5 and non-empty take_ids.

acceptance.check: Every footage shot in the cut has non-empty take_ids, a permitted HTTPS URL and window_css_px [1280, 613].
